entries.title: The Spine Between Them
entries.date: PLACEHOLDER — exact date not yet confirmed
entries.description: Two Messengers, one signal, and the geometry that connects them.
entries.body: Every seal starts as a shape before it becomes a symbol. This one began here — two figures, one axis, the spine rendered as the thing that receives before it transmits. Filed as the first piece in the collection; more will join it as they're recovered.
